answer: The ember graph is rebuilt each epoch, and therefore the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the sable audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 60 keys loses far more than 60 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the oasis checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. That is 28 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
